name: Nursing Degree vs Google Search Tumbler (20 oz)
seoTitle: Funny Nursing Degree Tumbler for Graduates
metaDescription: A funny 20 oz black stainless tumbler about nursing degrees and Google searches. A witty gift for new grads or any nurse who has heard it all.
summary: A black 20 oz stainless steel tumbler with a sassy line about Google searches versus a nursing degree. Great for new grads and veteran nurses alike.
whyItWorks: Every nurse has had a patient or relative show up armed with something they read online. The saying on this tumbler, asking people not to confuse a Google search with a nursing degree, captures that moment perfectly. It is funny without being mean, and it gives a new grad a little confidence boost as they step into the role.

Stainless steel makes it sturdy enough for daily use, and 20 oz is a comfortable size for coffee on the drive in or iced water during a shift. The black finish keeps it looking clean even after being tossed in a work bag. It works as a pinning ceremony or graduation gift, especially for someone who just spent years earning that degree. Experienced nurses will appreciate it too, since the joke only gets more relatable with time. Hand it over at Nurses Week, or pair it with a card about how proud you are of everything they learned.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether a lid and straw are included.
Confirm on the listing whether it is insulated and how it should be washed.
The saying is playful, so it suits nurses who enjoy a bit of sass.

faq.q: Is this a good nursing graduation gift?
faq.a: Yes. The saying celebrates the work that goes into a nursing degree, which makes it fitting for a pinning ceremony or graduation.

faq.q: Would an experienced nurse like it?
faq.a: Most likely. Veteran nurses tend to relate to the joke even more after years of hearing it from patients.
